classification.reason: The KB directly explains that two different-amount charges in one month typically reflect a prorated mid-cycle charge plus the regular renewal charge, and the customer is only asking for clarification, not requesting a refund or alleging fraud.

draft.reply:
Hi! Two different-amount charges in the same month usually happen when your member count crosses a plan threshold mid-cycle — that triggers a prorated charge for the added member(s) on top of your regular renewal charge, so the two amounts differ.

You can confirm this by going to Settings > Billing > Invoices — each charge should show up as its own line item there, so you can see exactly what each one covers.

If you take a look and the two charges turn out to be for the exact same amount on the exact same day, that would be a billing error rather than proration, so let me know and I'll get that escalated for you.
